items.quote: The assignment shall be performed on a full-time basis for an initial period of 24 months.
duty travel to Project sites in the regions of the Republic of Uzbekistan is required
Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (a CV describing relevant experience).
only the experience and qualifications of the respective individual candidate will be considered in the selection
Bachelor’s degree or higher in occupational health and safety, environmental or civil engineering, industrial safety, environmental sciences, public health, engineering, or another related field.
at least five (5) years of professional experience in OHS, including at least three (3) years of OHS experience on construction projects

practical experience in OHS management at construction, rehabilitation or infrastructure sites, contractor monitoring, conducting inspections and risk assessments, incident investigation, and development or application of OHS plans, ESMPs/C-ESMPs, or similar documents
familiarity with applicable environmental and social requirements
Experience in projects financed by international financial institutions or development partners, as well as familiarity with World Bank requirements, will be an advantage.
excellent command of Uzbek and Russian and a good working knowledge of English
The candidate ranked first based on the CV evaluation may be invited for an interview to confirm his/her qualifications, experience and availability for the assignment.
setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest
Expressions of Interest, supported by CVs, must be submitted in writing to the address below (in person, by mail, or by e-mail) by 28 September 2026.
